title: TS-01 Workspace CI gates: dry-run gate and manifest checks (rename deferred)
description:
## Slice 2 ticket 1 of 40, phase notes: paths use `conversation/` (the workspace as it is on develop). Design source: `git show origin/docs/typescript-control-plane:docs/TYPESCRIPT_CONTROL_PLANE.md` (section 8, row 1); read sections 0.3, 2, 3 and 6 as needed. Read AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md first. Never read or write `project/`; use `kbs` only.

## Goal
Harden the existing conversation/ workspace CI so every later ticket is gated the same way: typecheck, vitest, cucumber-js, and a cucumber-js --dry-run gate that fails on any undefined or ambiguous step in a manifest feature. The design doc also names a directory rename conversation/ to control-plane/ (package @chatticus/control-plane); the caller of this ticket set pinned every path to conversation/, so this ticket does NOT rename. If the product owner later wants the rename it is a separate git mv ticket.

## Kind
design-then-build: the behaviour and interfaces are fully specified below and in docs/TYPESCRIPT_CONTROL_PLANE.md. Where this text is silent and a decision would be needed, stop and report instead of inventing.

## Branch and commit
```text
git fetch origin
git switch -c ts/01-workspace-ci-gates-dry-run-gate-and-mani origin/develop
...work, then...
git add <only the files listed under Files>
git commit -m "feat(conversation): workspace CI gates: dry-run gate and manifest checks (rename deferred)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>"
git push -u origin ts/01-workspace-ci-gates-dry-run-gate-and-mani
```
Do NOT open a pull request; the orchestrator opens it. Commit messages contain no emojis.

## Files to create or change
- `conversation/test/cucumber-dry-run.test.ts` (new vitest: spawns `npx cucumber-js --dry-run --format summary` from conversation/, asserts exit code 0 and output without the words undefined or ambiguous)
- `conversation/package.json` (add script "test:features:dry": "cucumber-js --dry-run")
- `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (in the `conversation` job add a step `Ported features dry run` running `npm run test:features:dry` in working-directory conversation, after the Ported features step)
- `conversation/test/ported-features-manifest.test.ts` (keep; add a case that every manifest path begins with `features/` and ends with `.feature`)

## Exported interface and error behavior
No runtime exports. The vitest case must have no skips.

General rules: TypeScript ESM, `.ts` import suffixes as in conversation/src/storage/; tabs for indentation as in existing files; long clear names; no line comments; TSDoc on exported symbols; no emojis. Each Python exception class used by a ported function becomes an exported `Error` subclass with the same name and the same message text. Failures are thrown, never returned as magic values, unless the Python returned them.

## Behavior spec (Gherkin, ported unchanged)
Existing features that must pass under cucumber-js when this ticket closes. Do NOT edit these `.feature` files except where this ticket says a behavior changed.

### features/daily_budget_rollup.feature  (already ported in slice 1)
Scenarios: Daily rollup writes org environment and day attribution; Combined spend is a report not a third meter; Vendor threshold crossing publishes once to the budgets topic; A second daily run while still over threshold does not republish; AWS Budget alert is recorded without looping rollup messages; PascalCase AWS Budgets payload is recorded; Cost Explorer lag leaves AWS pending without treating it as zero; Cost Explorer quiet day is zero attributed not pending; AWS-billed ledger rows do not double-count vendor dollars; Re-run updates the same rollup row without duplicating; Cross-tenant Cost Explorer data does not leak; A customer-account organization's spend is read from its own account; A customer account that cannot be read is not reported as zero; A customer account whose data is still loading stays pending; One unreadable customer account does not stop other organizations; A hosted organization is unreadable while the tenant cost tag is not active; A customer-account organization does not depend on the tenant cost tag; An active tenant cost tag with no spend for a hosted organization reads as zero
Steps already live in conversation/features-support/steps/daily-budget-rollup.steps.ts; keep them passing, add nothing.
Cucumber expressions: convert each Python `{name}` parse pattern to `{string}`, `{int}` or `{word}` using `npx tsx conversation/bin/convert-step-pattern.ts '<pattern>'` (from ticket 3) and review the output by hand. Step text must not change unless behavior changed. Steps call `this.api` (HTTP via `app.request()`) for HTTP steps and the same domain functions the routes call for direct steps; steps never reach into a store.
Step file(s) to write: under `conversation/features-support/steps/` as named in Files above (at most about 400 lines each; split by subject).

Failing run first (required):
```text
1. Write or port the step file(s) and any new .feature file.
2. cd conversation && npx cucumber-js ../features/<feature>.feature   -> confirm the scenarios FAIL for the right reason (missing production code, not a typo in a step). Save the first failing summary line for the commit body.
3. Write the smallest production code that passes. Re-run until green.
```
Manifest: when EVERY scenario of a feature is covered by this ticket (not marked partial above), add `features/<name>.feature` to `features/ported-features.txt` and add `<name>` to the alternation in `python/behave.ini` `exclude_re` (the manifest vitest `conversation/test/ported-features-manifest.test.ts` fails if they disagree). For a partial feature leave the manifest alone; the ticket named in the note finishes it. To run a partial feature, pass the path and `--name '<scenario>'` to cucumber-js; if CLI paths do not override the config paths, stop and report.

## Dependencies (blocked-by)
- none

## Verify
```text
cd conversation && npm run typecheck && npm test && npx cucumber-js ../features/<each feature of this ticket>.feature
```
moto setup (copied from the `conversation` job in .github/workflows/ci.yml):
```text
python -m pip install "moto[server]==5.2.3"
nohup moto_server -p 5555 > moto.log 2>&1 &
for i in $(seq 1 30); do if (echo > /dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/5555) 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; sleep 1; done
export CHATTICUS_TEST_AWS_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:5555
```
Install once at the repo root: `npm ci`. Stop moto when done: `pkill -f "moto_server -p 5555"`.
If the ticket added a feature to the manifest also run `cd conversation && npx cucumber-js` (full manifest) and `cd python && behave` is NOT required for ported features, but run `cd python && black --check src ../features tests && ruff check src ../features tests` if you touched anything under python/ or features/steps/.
Final cleanup before pushing:
```text
git status
```
Make sure NO `.orig`, `.rej`, `node_modules`, `build/`, `dist/`, `moto.log`, `.venv` or other stray files are staged: `git diff --cached --name-only | grep -E '\.orig$|\.rej$|node_modules|(^|/)build/|(^|/)dist/|moto\.log|\.venv'` must print nothing.

## Notes
Judgement-free: do exactly the four edits. Do not touch python/ or features/.

## Stop rules
If anything in this ticket is wrong, ambiguous, impossible, or contradicted by the code you find (a Python line range does not match, a step has no Python match, a library API differs from what is written, a scenario cannot pass without changing its text), STOP and report to the orchestrator with the exact file, line and observation. Never improvise, never weaken or delete a scenario to make it pass, never add a fallback or a compatibility branch.

## Python to delete
No production Python is deleted by this ticket (the one big deletion is ticket 40). The only deletions allowed: the per-feature step file of each feature newly added to the manifest, because the manifest vitest requires it: nothing. Shared step files (control_plane_steps.py, capability_policy_steps.py, messaging_steps.py, organization_steps.py and the like) are never edited here; the last ticket that uses them leaves them for ticket 40.
right_now_summary: The workspace CI gate work is defined, with the directory rename deferred.
